description: fnpf_3d_coral_amr_restart on 2 ranks: the checkpoint of the one-rank run on another decomposition, the outputs cut back on rank 0. The text outputs (CORAL, 6DOF, wave gauges) have the rows of the uninterrupted one-rank run, their values within 1e-4 of its largest value (the last 10 steps solved on 2 ranks: about 1e-5); the log of the refinement (ranks, iterations) not compared.
covers: the restart of FNPF + mesh refinement + CORAL on another decomposition
